correctness.rationale: For all \(m\ge2\), \(B=(I+U)(I+V)\) on the even parity torus. Both diagonal moves have m orbits intersecting in two sites; hence ker(I+U) lies in im(I+V), and \(\dim\ker B=2m\). The kernel-evaluation separation handles all site pairs, including displacement (m,m) using an indicator U-orbit preimage under I+V. The analogous left kernel condition follows by color-swapping translation. An exact rank-two update lemma adds two for two disjoint omitted edges and rank-one adds one for incident edges, proving \(S=2m^2-2m+\nu(F)\) and flat Schmidt spectrum. Replayed checker.py passes 36,480 exact rank comparisons, but finite evidence is not used as proof.

value.rationale: The new complete two-defect response on a canonical periodic 2D graph-state family is an exact structural stability classification: all disjoint gate omissions have additive two-bit entanglement improvement, while adjacent omissions have one-bit improvement. This is not guaranteed by the known single-edge result: explicitly checked \(C_4\square C_6\) and published three-dimensional tori exhibit disjoint two-gate cancellation. The all-location distinction is physically motivated by entanglement sensitivity of ideal lattice preparations and mathematically explained by an exact kernel-separation property; no fault-tolerance or device advantage is inferred.
